title: campanula rotundifolia f. scabriuscula
intro: Campanula rotundifolia f. scabriuscula, commonly known as the heather bellflower or Scottish heather, is a flowering plant species within the Campanula genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to soothe and protect the body. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia f. scabriuscula include its potential to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and insecticidal properties, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses.
